EN: Hello!
ZH: 你好！

EN: Busy?
ZH: 忙吗？

EN: I've been working out. Building up my bis, tris, quads, pecs.
ZH: 我最近在健身。练二头、三头、股四头，还有胸肌。

EN: So, I've decided to write the great American novel. It's about all of us!
ZH: 我决定要写那部伟大的美国小说，写的就是我们所有人！

EN: You heard the one about the football coach and the waitress?
ZH: 你听过那个足球教练和女招待的段子吗？

EN: Have you read the book yet? For book club?
ZH: 你读那本书了吗？就是读书俱乐部要求的那个？

EN: Do you smell something funny?
ZH: 你闻到什么奇怪的味道了吗？

EN: Wow, I have the jitters! Too much caffeine!
ZH: 哇，我现在手抖心慌！咖啡喝多了！

EN: Ugh. I have this itch. I don't suppose you could... you know.
ZH: 呃。我这儿有点痒。我说，你能不能……你懂的。

EN: Can you help with my crossword? Five-letter word, ends with “t.” - “Often terrible, always uncomfortable.”
ZH: 帮我解个填字游戏。三个字，“常常很糟，总是难受”。

EN: Need help with this crossword. Nine letters. Starts with “c” and ends with “d.” Means, “A horror you can never escape.”
ZH: 帮我解个填字游戏。四个字，“一场永远逃不掉的恐怖”。

EN: Got this song stuck in my head. “Baby, yeah, babbbbyyy! You can light my...”
ZH: 脑子里一直有首歌洗脑循环。“宝贝，耶——宝贝——！你能点燃我的……”

EN: Is it night or day? I've lost track.
ZH: 现在是白天还是晚上，我迷糊了。

EN: Have you seen my best friend?
ZH: 你看到我最好的朋友了吗？

EN: What would win in a fight? A Radscorpion or a Yao Guai?
ZH: 辐射蝎和妖怪熊打架，谁会赢？

EN: Hmm. Maybe. But only if I can deal.
ZH: 嗯。也许吧。除非让我发牌。

EN: Sure. Poker. We'll play for Caps.
ZH: 好啊，玩扑克，输了要给瓶盖。

EN: No thanks. I'm going to play solitaire instead.
ZH: 不，谢了。我还是一个人吧。

EN: Oh, that's easy. A hippo. Definitely a hippo.
ZH: 这个问题容易。我觉得是河马，绝对是河马。

EN: Hmmm... Maybe a monkey. Those things are creepy.
ZH: 嗯……猴子吧。我最怕猴子了。

EN: Probably a shark. With legs.
ZH: 我觉得应该是鲨鱼。有腿的那种。

EN: Other Vaults? There are other Vaults?
ZH: 其他的避难所吗？还有其他的避难所？

EN: You know, I've never thought about it. Our Vault is so amazing, why would I?
ZH: 你知道吗，我还真没想过。我们的避难所这么棒，我干嘛还想别的？

EN: I bet... two others. Maybe three. Or five hundred.
ZH: 我敢打赌……两个。也许三个。或者五百个。

EN: Chocolate. Definitely chocolate.
ZH: 巧克力。绝对是巧克力味的。

EN: Triple-layer vanilla walnut. With a coconut fondant.
ZH: 三层香草核桃味，外面裹一层椰子翻糖。

EN: Raisinberry! Wait... is that even a real fruit?
ZH: 葡萄干莓子味！等等……真的有这种水果吗？

EN: What? You mean now? RIGHT now?
ZH: 什么？你说现在？此时此刻？

EN: I know! It's a little creepy, isn't it?
ZH: 我知道！这有点吓人，不是吗？

EN: You're imagining things.
ZH: 你在瞎想。

EN: Nah. But a robot servant would be pretty great.
ZH: 不要。但有个机器人做仆人挺好的。

EN: You know, I always wanted a dog.
ZH: 你知道，我一直想要一只狗。

EN: I'd love a chameleon. But I bet the radiation would make it all... weird.
ZH: 我想养只变色龙。但我打赌辐射会让它变得……奇怪。

EN: Sure. But only if I get to play first base. That's where all the action is.
ZH: 当然。但得让我守一垒才行。好戏都在那儿上演。

EN: Nah. I'm more of a croquet person myself.
ZH: 不了，我更喜欢打门球。

EN: Baseball? Inside the Vault? Good luck with that.
ZH: 棒球吗？在避难所里？呵呵，祝你好运。

EN: Hmmm... “Raider”?
ZH: 嗯……“掠夺者”？

EN: Oh, I know! “Corpse”!
ZH: 哦，我知道了！“尸体”！

EN: Try “Nitwit.”
ZH: 试试“土包子”。

EN: Oh! I read that one. She dies at the end. It's really sad.
ZH: 哦！那本我看过。她最后死了。真是悲伤。

EN: I read that, too. Seven times. We really need more books...
ZH: 我也读过。七遍。我们真的需要更多的书了……

EN: “Rulers and Wrenches”? Yeah, that's a good one.
ZH: 《尺子和扳手》？嗯，这本不错。

EN: Hmm... Probably that giant ball of yarn. Always did want to see that.
ZH: 嗯……大概是那个巨大的毛线球吧。一直想去看看。

EN: Oh, the Eiffel Tower. Definitely. So romantic. Assuming, you know... it's still there.
ZH: 哦，埃菲尔铁塔，必须是它。多浪漫啊。前提是，你懂的……它还在的话。

EN: The Great Wall of China. I bet it's still standing.
ZH: 中国的长城，我敢打赌一定还在。

EN: I know! Flies the size of dogs! Scorpions the size of cows! Glad I'm not out there.
ZH: 可不是嘛！苍蝇和狗一般大！蝎子和牛一般大！真高兴我不在那儿。

EN: I've heard there are lots of animals with two heads. Apparently it's a theme.
ZH: 我听说外面好多动物都长两个头。看来这是个“标配”呀。

EN: I don't know. Some of them sound kind of cute. Like “Yao Guai” - how bad could that be?
ZH: 我不知道，有些名字听起来还挺萌的。比如说“妖怪熊”，能有多糟呀？

EN: Compared to what exactly?
ZH: 具体是跟什么比呢？

EN: Of course we are! The Overseer would never let anything happen to us!
ZH: 当然了！监督者不会让我们发生任何意外的！

EN: Safer than we'd be outside, that's for sure!
ZH: 肯定比我们在外面要安全！

EN: Maybe. So long as you don't start dancing. It's kind of embarrassing.
ZH: 可以啊。只要你不跳舞就行。会有点尴尬。

EN: Okay, but no sad songs! I need to stay positive.
ZH: 好吧，但别放伤感的歌，我想保持积极的态度！

EN: Sure! Maybe we can pick up a frequency from someone on the outside...
ZH: 好呀！说不定还能收到外面什么人的电台信号……

EN: Probably a renowned Swiss chocolatier. What? I like chocolate.
ZH: 也许会选一位著名的瑞士巧克力大师吧。怎么了？我喜欢巧克力不行么。

EN: A great comedian! I mean, no offense, but your jokes kind of stink.
ZH: 我想选一位伟大的喜剧演员！没其他意思，但你的笑话真烂。

EN: A famous author. They could write my biography: “Dweller: A Profile in Awesomeness.”
ZH: 想要一位名作家。他可以给我的自传起名：“居民：酷炫人生侧写”。

EN: How about “perambulate”?
ZH: “溜达”这个词怎么样？

EN: Oh, I know - “super amazingly great”!
ZH: 哦，我知道——“超级惊人的伟大”！

EN: “Vertebrate”? “Stablemate”? “Encapsulate”? Or maybe just “ate.“
ZH: “拉萨”？“爸爸”？“长大”？或者“害怕”。

EN: Nobody's home. See what I did there?
ZH: 没人在家。懂我的梗了吧？

EN: No. NO. Please, no “knock knock” jokes...
ZH: 不。别。求你了，别再讲“咚咚咚”的笑话……

EN: Aggh! Somebody's knocking on the Vault door! It's a Raider! He'll kill us all!
ZH: 啊！有人在敲避难所大门！是掠夺者！他会杀了我们所有人！

EN: A castle. With a moat, and battlements, and a drawbridge. Oh, and dragons. Got to have dragons.
ZH: 一座城堡。有护城河，和城垛，和吊桥。哦，还有龙。一定得有龙。

EN: Another Vault, all to myself, where nobody can ask me stupid questions.
ZH: 另一个避难所，只有我一个人，这样就没有人问我这些愚蠢的问题了。

EN: Um... a house?
ZH: 嗯……一座房子？

EN: No thanks. I've seen your drawings...
ZH: 不，谢了。我看过你的画……

EN: Aw, that's so sweet of you. How about a lighthouse?
ZH: 噢，你真贴心。画个灯塔怎么样？

EN: A drawing of the Overseer. Now THAT would be something...
ZH: 画一张监督者的像。那可就有意思了……

EN: I know! I can't believe she did that! The nerve of some people.
ZH: 是啊！真不敢相信她会那么做！有些人脸皮可真厚。

EN: Oh, you mean that, er... situation? With the thing? Oh, I heard all right.
ZH: 哦，你是说，呃……那件事？跟那个玩意儿有关的那件？哦，我可听说了。

EN: I didn't, no. But that's okay. Unlike some people, I don't like to spread gossip...
ZH: 我没有听说过。不过没关系。不像某些人，我可不喜欢传小话……

EN: Sure is. And he seemed like such a nice guy.
ZH: 肯定是真的。可他以前看起来人挺好的。

EN: I really hope not. I hate the idea of living in the same Vault with a person like that.
ZH: 我希望不是真的。我讨厌和那样的人住在同一个避难所。

EN: What? No! Of course it isn't true! Really, you can't believe everything you hear...
ZH: 什么？不！这当然不是真的！说真的，听到的话可不能全信……

EN: Nope. Never. I love living in the Vault. This is my home... and always will be.
ZH: 不。永远不会。我喜欢住在避难所里。这是我的家……永远都是。

EN: Well, maybe. But it depends on what they have out there. Carnivals? Street car races? Cotton candy? I mean, it would have to be worth it.
ZH: 好吧，也许吧。但这得看外面有什么。嘉年华？街头赛车？棉花糖？我是说，得值得我出去才行。

EN: Ha! Like it will ever be safe out there...
ZH: 哈！说得好像外面哪天能安全似的……

EN: Oh my goodness! Thank you so much. I appreciate everything you do, too.
ZH: 哦，天哪！太感谢你了！你做的一切也让我很感激。

EN: Oh. Well. Um... Isn't that... sweet?
ZH: 哦。呃。嗯……这不是……挺贴心的吗？

EN: Finally, somebody recognizes how invaluable I am!
ZH: 终于，有人知道我是多么宝贵！

EN: You can say that again.
ZH: 可不是嘛！

EN: Tell me about it. Life in the Vault, huh?
ZH: 可不是么。在避难所里的日子，你懂的。

EN: Right? But I wouldn't trade it for anything.
ZH: 对吧？不过给我什么都不换。

EN: Probably just something quick. Maybe a bowl of Sugar Bombs.
ZH: 大概来点什么马上能吃的吧。也许一碗糖衣炸弹麦片。

EN: Oh, I could eat Fancy Lads Snack Cakes for any meal. In fact, I usually do.
ZH: 哦，我可以顿顿吃俏男孩夹心蛋糕。其实我经常这样。

EN: Same thing I have for dinner every night - a can of Pork 'n Beans and an ice cold Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 每晚的晚餐都是老一套——一罐猪肉豆子，加一瓶冰镇核子可乐。

EN: Checkers? What are we, ten years old? We'll play chess.
ZH: 跳棋？我们才十岁吗？我们还是下象棋吧。

EN: Sure! That sounds like fun!
ZH: 跳棋不错啊！听起来很有趣！

EN: Oh, maybe. I'll check my duty schedule and get back to you.
ZH: 哦，也许可以。我查一下我的排班表，然后和你说。

EN: You know, I think it is. Someone needs to check the seals on the Vault door.
ZH: 我想是的。有人应该检查一下避难所大门的密封是否还好。

EN: It's just you.
ZH: 只有你这么觉得。

EN: The environmental controls may be on the fritz again. Can't say I'm surprised.
ZH: 环境控制器可能又坏了。我一点儿都不奇怪。

EN: Depends. What color is the unicycle?
ZH: 得看情况。独轮车是什么颜色的？

EN: Hmmm. I mean, it's hard to beat a shark. But lumberjacks are really tough. I just can't decide.
ZH: 嗯，我觉得，鲨鱼很难被打败，但伐木工人真的很强悍。我判断不出来。

EN: Why do they have to fight? Why can't they just be friends and go grab coffee?
ZH: 为什么要打架？为什么他们不能成为朋友，然后一起喝咖啡呢？

EN: Really? That's so great to hear. Thank you!
ZH: 真的吗？很高兴听你这么说。谢谢你！

EN: From who? The Overseer? Has the Overseer been talking about me?!
ZH: 谁说的？监督者吗？监督者居然一直在谈论我？！

EN: Oh, you know, I just do the best I can. If it helps the Vault, it helps us all.
ZH: 哎哟，你知道的，我就是尽力而为。只要对避难所有帮助，就是对大家有帮助。

EN: Cheese.
ZH: 奶酪味的。

EN: Why the classic, of course - pepperoni.
ZH: 当然是经典口味——意大利辣味香肠披萨。

EN: I prefer a Hawaiian Mongolian Neapolitan blend. But no anchovies.
ZH: 我偏爱夏威夷、蒙古、那不勒斯三种风味的混搭。但不要凤尾鱼。

EN: Sure. Football or baseball?
ZH: 行啊。橄榄球还是棒球？

EN: I never learned how to catch. But you should see me throw!
ZH: 我从来都不会接球。但你应该看看我怎么投球的！

EN: Not really. But you want to kick the soccer ball around instead?
ZH: 不是很想。我们踢足球怎么样？

EN: What are you, 12?
ZH: 真是幼稚，以为自己12岁吗？

EN: Hmmmm. Bacon.
ZH: 嗯……猪头呗。

EN: Just dwellin' like a felon.
ZH: 混着呗，跟个惯犯似的。

EN: The day that happens is the day I wander into the Wasteland.
ZH: 真到那一天，我就出门去逛废土了。

EN: Really? I think you'd make a great Overseer!
ZH: 真的吗？我想你会成为一个伟大的监督者！

EN: Fine by me. I'll blindly follow anyone with a title and authority.
ZH: 我无所谓。我会盲目跟随任何有头衔和权威的人。

EN: Yes! The others told me! It sounds so... dangerous!
ZH: 听说了！别人告诉我的！听起来好……危险！

EN: Well, I have, but I don't believe it.
ZH: 听说过，但我不相信。

EN: No, I haven't. Is it anything like... the whatchamacallit?
ZH: 没听说过。是有点像那个……叫什么来着的东西？

EN: I have a hammer. Same thing.
ZH: 我有一把锤子。一回事。

EN: Phillips, flat, square, Frearson, Pozidriv or JIS?
ZH: 你要哪种？菲利普斯、平头、方头、弗里尔森、米字还是日标的？

EN: Sure do. You can borrow it for 200 Caps.
ZH: 当然。给200个瓶盖我就借给你。

EN: Hmmm? Probably weaponize it. To fight the Mole Men.
ZH: 嗯？可以把它变成武器。去打鼹鼠人。

EN: Well, I'd burn to death, I'm guessing.
ZH: 好吧，我猜我会被烧死的。

EN: Oh, that's easy. I'd be a new thermogenerator. Because... POWER!
ZH: 哦，那还不简单。我本人就会变成一台新的温差发电器。因为……电力！

EN: Who's there? Wait. You know what? Never mind. I don't care.
ZH: 谁在那儿？等等。算了，我才懒得问。

EN: Come on in
ZH: 进来吧！

EN: Oh my God! Raiders at the Vault Door! Raiders at the Vault Door!
ZH: 哦，我的天啊！掠夺者来了！掠夺者来了！

EN: Nah. I can barely speak this one.
ZH: 不想，现在这门语言我自己都说不利索。

EN: I'd love to learn binary code, so I can bargain for my life when the robots enslave us all.
ZH: 我想学二进制代码，这样等机器人奴役我们的时候，我还能跟它们谈谈保命的价码。

EN: Ah, but I am already fluent in the language... of love.
ZH: 啊，但我早已精通一门语言了……那就是爱。

EN: Don't worry. That was never on my agenda.
ZH: 别担心。从来就不在我的日程安排里。

EN: Yeah, looks like you're coming down with an acute case of hypochondria.
ZH: 是啊，看起来你得了急性疑心病。

EN: Oooh, what is it? Black Death? Typhus? Super Ebola? The Blue Flu?
ZH: 哦，什么病？黑死病？斑疹伤寒？超级埃博拉病毒？蓝流感？

EN: My goodness! Who could have done such a thing! *burp*
ZH: 我的天啊！谁能做出这样的事！*饱嗝声*

EN: Wow. That is... quite a predicament. I'm sure the Overseer will see to this personally. Really.
ZH: 哇。这可真是个……难题。我相信监督者肯定会亲自处理的。真的。

EN: That's terrible! You just don't mess with a person's sweetroll...
ZH: 太可怕了！谁也不能乱动人家的甜卷……

EN: That you live with a bunch of slobs?
ZH: 说明你和一群懒汉生活在一起吗？

EN: Isn't it obvious? Someone's been disintegrated!
ZH: 这还不明显吗？有人被分解成灰了！

EN: It can only mean one thing – nudie party!
ZH: 这只能说明一件事——裸体派对！

EN: A dictionary, so you can look up the definition of “selfish.”
ZH: 一本字典，这样你就可以查查“自私”的定义。

EN: Hand-knitted socks, of course. They're my specialty.
ZH: 当然是手织袜子。这是我的拿手活。

EN: A one-way ticket to the Wasteland.
ZH: 一张去废土的单程票。

EN: You know it! I'll gladly lay down my life for this Vault!
ZH: 那当然！我很乐意为这个避难所献出生命！

EN: Yeeeeaahhh... See, I'm more of a “lover not a fighter” type.
ZH: 是……是啊……你看，比起当战士，我更适合当爱人。

EN: Absolutely. I'll be there right next to you. Well, maybe behind you...
ZH: 当然。我就站在你身旁。好吧，也许在你身后……

EN: Oh, it's... fine. Not good. Not bad. You know. Just sort of... meh.
ZH: 哦，还……行吧。不好也不坏。你懂的，就是有点……一般般。

EN: Wait... do you really want to know? Or is that just your way of saying “Hi”?
ZH: 等等……你真想知道？还是说这只是你打招呼的方式？

EN: How's it going, you ask? Why it's going fantastic! *Play along – the Overseer might be listening.*
ZH: 你问我过得怎么样？嘿，好得不得了！*配合着演——监督者可能正听着呢。*

EN: Oh, you know. A ceiling made of steel. With a copious amount of asbestos, by the looks of it.
ZH: 哦，你知道的。钢制的天花板。看样子石棉用量还相当可观。

EN: Not much! Just happy that I'm here in the Vault, and not out in the Wasteland! You know... dying.
ZH: 没什么！就是高兴自己待在避难所里，而不是待在外头废土上！你知道的……等死。

EN: Well, I'm busy. What about you? Don't YOU have somewhere else to be? Hint hint.
ZH: 我很忙。你呢？你不是该有别的地方要去吗？你懂的。

EN: Hmph.
ZH: 哼。

EN: Well hey there!
ZH: 嘿，你好呀！

EN: Always great to see you. Really.
ZH: 总是很高兴见到你。真的。

EN: Nah, not really.
ZH: 不，不太忙。

EN: Busy as a bee tucked away in a subterranean steel honeycomb!
ZH: 忙得像只蜜蜂，藏在地下的钢铁蜂窝里！

EN: Do I LOOK busy?
ZH: 我看起来很忙吗？

EN: Wow, yeah! I can totally tell! Lookin' good!
ZH: 哇，是的！我完全可以看得出来！看起来还不错！

EN: Really? I never would have known.
ZH: 真的吗？你不说我完全不知道。

EN: Might want to tighten up those glutes.
ZH: 你也许该考虑再提提臀。

EN: Oooh! Am I one of the main characters? I bet I am. I mean, how could I not be?
ZH: 哦！我是主要角色之一吗？我敢打赌肯定是。我是说，我怎么可能不是呢？

EN: Just change my name, okay? I value what little privacy I have down here.
ZH: 把我的名字换掉，好吗？我在底下仅剩的那点隐私可宝贝着呢。

EN: You? Write a novel? Have you maybe considered... a coloring book instead?
ZH: 你？写一本小说？有没有考虑过……还是改画涂色书？

EN: I have! And the waitress says, “Keep the change? But I'm wearing denim!” Ha ha ha ha! Love that one...
ZH: 我听过！然后女服务员说：“不用找了？可我穿着牛仔服呢！”哈哈哈哈！最爱这笑话……

EN: Sorry, no time for jokes.
ZH: 对不起，没有时间开玩笑。

EN: Yes. From you. Several times.
ZH: 是的。听你讲的。好几遍了。

EN: Yep, sure have. I can't believe she died at the end. From chicken pox. So sad.
ZH: 嗯，看了。真不敢相信她最后死了。死于水痘。太悲伤了。

EN: Oh, darn. Was that this week? I totally forgot.
ZH: 哦，糟糕。是这周的事吗？我完全忘了。

EN: No. I keep telling you I only read Grognak.
ZH: 没，我一直跟你说我只读《野蛮人古古那》。

EN: Nope. Nothing. But you may have a sinus infection.
ZH: 什么都没有呀。你可能有鼻窦感染吧。

EN: Just the usual. Sweat, oil, steel, moldy bread and loneliness.
ZH: 还是老样子呗。汗味、机油、钢铁、发霉的面包，还有孤独。

EN: Yes, actually. I noticed it just as you walked up...
ZH: 其实我闻到了。就在你走过来的时候……

EN: Me too! I should probably stop spiking my Nuka-Cola with espresso...
ZH: 我也是！也许我该停止往核子可乐里掺浓缩咖啡了……

EN: That's the spirit! Decaf is for the weak.
ZH: 这就对了！脱因咖啡是弱者才喝的。

EN: Ssshh. Don't let the Overseer hear. You'll get assigned a double shift.
ZH: 嘘。别让监督者听见。不然要罚你上双班的。

EN: Yeeeeaaah. Not gonna happen.
ZH: 呃……想得美。

EN: Touch you? I... I mean... scratch your... body?
ZH: 摸你吗？我……我是说……挠你的……身体？

EN: Of course! Always happy to help a friend in need.
ZH: 当然！总是乐于帮助有需要的朋友。

EN: Sorry, I'm more of a math person.
ZH: 抱歉，我是搞数学的那类人。

EN: That's easy. Bigot. No, wait – Theft! Yeast?
ZH: 这还不简单。“苦大仇深”。不对，等等——“水深火热”！“叫苦连天”？

EN: Vault.
ZH: 避难所。

EN: Cornfield?
ZH: 字谜成瘾？

EN: Duuuuhh... Cat?
ZH: 呃……是猫吗？

EN: Crossword.
ZH: 填字游戏。
